Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 1+1+blk
– Porcelan, prane UET
– Rruga Kongresi i Manastirit
– Pallat ekzistues
– Kati 5
– Siperfaqja 54m²
– Cmimi 98,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 1+1+blk, me siperfaqe 54m², i cili ndodhet ne katin 5 te nje pallati ekzistues, i pozicionuar ne Porcelan pas Universitetit Europian te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ka organizim shume mire, qe perbehet nga korridori, sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 1 dhome gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkoni.
Apartamenti shitet bosh, eshte i shtruar me parket, ka dyer cilesore, dritare dopio xham dhe tualeti eshte i kompletuar me hidrosanitare. Tarraca eshte e izoluar dhe e rregulluar.
Orientimi Jug-Lindje-Perendim.
Disponon dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
description_en: Property characteristics: - Apartment 1+1+blk - Porcelan, near UET - Congress Street of Manastir - Existing building - 5th floor - Area 54m² - Price 98,000 Euro Apartment 1+1+blk, with an area of ​​54m², is for sale, which is located on the 5th floor of an existing building, located in Porcelan, behind the European University of Tirana. The apartment has a very good organization, consisting of a corridor, a living room, a kitchen, 1 bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. The apartment is sold empty, it is laid with parquet, it has quality doors, double-glazed windows and the toilet is complete with hydrosanitary. The terrace is insulated and arranged. Orientation South-East-West. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
